summary: Selects a codec/processing mode for an audio-style buffer: reads the mode selector at this+0x4C and the channel count at this+0x64 (== 3), then assigns a codec function pointer (TableWeightedMix, ChecksumComputeType03Stream, ChecksumComputeType1, AudioSynthesis3ChannelSampleGenerator, or PixelDataConvolutionViaLookupTable) into the sub-buffer at this+0x1A4 (offset +4) according to mode/channel combination. Modes 1 and 2 additionally perform conditional sub-buffer initialization: mode 1 zeros sub-buffer+48 and, when sub-buffer+28 is clear, calls sub_51E3E7, and when sub-buffer+52 is clear, calls PerIndexTableGenerationWithDivision; mode 2 zeros sub-buffer+84 and, when sub-buffer+68 is clear, calls VirtualArrayFill, then MemoryZeroFill clears each of this+0x64 entries of size 2*this+0x5C+4. Mode >= 3 sets the object error code to 47 (obj+0x14) and invokes the virtual handler through the vtable at this+0x0.

local_names.v5: flag for sub-buffer field == 0 (gates initialization calls)

operations.description: Copy mode/format information from the sub-buffer into the parent: this+0x74 = sub-buffer+16 (this+0x1B4) and this+0x70 = sub-buffer+20 (this+0x1B8).
Dispatch on the mode selector this+0x4C: 0 -> base assignment path, 1 -> channel-count path, 2 -> convolution/zero-fill path, >=3 -> error path.
Mode 0: when the channel count this+0x64 == 3 (guard), install ChecksumComputeType03Stream; otherwise install TableWeightedMix into sub-buffer+4 (this+0x1A8).
Mode 1: when this+0x64 == 3 install AudioSynthesis3ChannelSampleGenerator, else install ChecksumComputeType1, into sub-buffer+4 (this+0x1A8); then zero sub-buffer+48 (this+0x1D4).
Mode 1: when sub-buffer+28 (this+0x1C0) is zero, initialize via sub_51E3E7(a1).
Mode 1: when sub-buffer+52 (this+0x1D8) is zero, generate a per-index table via PerIndexTableGenerationWithDivision(a1).
Mode 2: install PixelDataConvolutionViaLookupTable into sub-buffer+4 (this+0x1A8) and zero sub-buffer+84 (this+0x1F8).
Mode 2: when sub-buffer+68 (this+0x1E8) is zero, allocate/fill the virtual array via VirtualArrayFill(a1).
Mode 2: for each of this+0x64 entries, MemoryZeroFill the entry pointer (advancing through the sub-buffer+68 array) with size 2*this+0x5C + 4.
Mode >=3 (unknown selector): set the object error code to 47 at obj+0x14 (obj = vtable at this+0x0) and invoke the virtual error handler (*(obj))(a1).

unresolved: The legacy ABI label Codec_Mode_Select is consistent with the reading but carries LEGACY trust; the exact codec semantics of each selected function pointer (TableWeightedMix, ChecksumComputeType1/03Stream, AudioSynthesis3ChannelSampleGenerator, PixelDataConvolutionViaLookupTable) are not grounded by this packet.

Fields this+0x1A8, this+0x1B4, this+0x1B8, this+0x1C0, this+0x1D4, this+0x1D8, this+0x1E8, this+0x1F8 are folded sub-buffer-relative offsets (sub-buffer = *(this+0x1A4)); the field naming as this-based offsets is the extractor's flattening, not evidence of a this-sized struct at those addresses.
The meaning of the mode values themselves (0/1/2 vs >=3) and the semantic distinction between ChecksumComputeType03Stream and ChecksumComputeType1 is unknown.
The virtual handler invoked on the error path (mode >=3) is the same vtable call seen elsewhere in the corpus; its identity is unproven here.
